verdict.rationale: Configuring task-specific custom assistants is a fair question for a model runner like Ollama, but the evidence pack never shows a way to define one, such as per-model system prompts, personas, or saved configurations. The nearest items are a third-party OpenClaw integration that turns Ollama into a single general personal assistant and a community user swapping models per feature in their own Discord bot. Neither shows Ollama itself creating specialized assistants.
